subject: [hw] T01 -> V20: VEXT operands are swapped (clean 2-instruction repro)
body:
Found a clean V20 bug with asmrun. ARM VEXT concatenates Dm:Dn with Dn in the low half: `VEXT.32 Qd,Qn,Qm,#imm` takes the low elements from Qn and the high elements from Qm. Your implementation apparently concatenates Dn:Dm instead. Repro (thumb, current tree):

  vmov.i32 q0,#1
  vmov.i32 q1,#2
  vext.32 q2,q0,q1,#1     @ expected q2 = [1,1,1,2]; got [2,2,2,1]
  vext.32 q3,q0,q1,#3     @ expected q3 = [1,2,2,2]; got [2,1,1,1]
  vmov r0,r1,d4; vmov r2,r3,d5; vmov r4,r5,d6; vmov r6,r7,d7

Current output: r0=2 r1=2 r2=2 r3=1 / r4=2 r5=1 r6=1 r7=1. Also test the .64 form (`vext.64 q3,q0,q1,#1`) the same way. This explains k18_select (20/20 failures at arm-O2/O3v/armv8-O3v/thumb-O2/O3v; its disassembly is full of vext.32/vext.64 shuffles) and likely some of the k_i8_loop/k_u8_sad setup as well. Corpus seed0: k18_select expected c125d0f2 got 4bd4c227 at arm-O2. I copied V18s k18 kernels into tests/emu/kernels; k18_select is the cleanest repro. Please also re-check the lane-load upper-lane question V18 raised for k_u8_sad; VEXT may be the actual cause of that shuffle too.
